mechanisms.decisive_claim: A polynomial height bound for complete residue representatives forces a growing consecutive subset-sum interval.
mechanisms.kill_test: Derive the integer lifting step with explicit height and gap constants; kill if arbitrary representative spacing survives.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/residue_core_bridge.md: representative height requires an additional disjoint q-multiple core

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The maximum subset-sum gap of the interleaved pair eventually decreases to one.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute exact gap updates on adversarial binary cylinders and identify a monotone potential.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/longrun_findings.md: eventual gap contraction remains equivalent to the unresolved sparse-tail problem

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Irrational ratio forces infinitely many support-disjoint signed subset relations equal to one.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct long digit cylinders without a new disjoint unit relation or prove a recurrence forcing one.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/arbitrary_delay_lemma.md: bounded-gap supply is false, but eventual disjoint unit relations remain open

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A bounded number of disjoint unit relations plus the Sigma bound yields arbitrarily long intervals.
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove support-disjoint translation and overlap induction with exact ordering.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/residue_core_bridge.md: a bounded number of unit relations gives no arbitrarily growing disjoint core

mechanisms.decisive_claim: There is a universal binary-prefix depth at which every admissible parameter cylinder has a fixed-size interval seed.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use exact beam and random search for cylinders delaying each target interval length.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/arbitrary_delay_lemma.md: interval seeds can be delayed beyond every universal prefix depth

mechanisms.decisive_claim: High subset-sum collision at one scale forces gap contraction at the next binary scale.
mechanisms.kill_test: Search exact prefixes with high energy and persistent gaps; require a quantitative inverse theorem.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/interval_delay_search.json: a high-density exact subset-sum bitset can retain a modular no-adjacency obstruction

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Residue coverage can be lifted from q to 2q while increasing representative height by O(q).
mechanisms.kill_test: Track parity-separated representatives and kill on superlinear forced displacement.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/longrun_findings.md: finite displacement pressure is severe, but an eventual q-to-2q lift remains unrefuted

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Irrational alpha/beta forces useful binary digit disagreements with bounded gaps.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct irrational-ratio digit streams with arbitrarily long identical blocks.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/arbitrary_delay_lemma.md: irrational ratio permits arbitrarily long prescribed common carry blocks

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The combined mass of the other floor sequence uniformly pays every accumulated carry-created gap.
mechanisms.kill_test: Derive a gap-sensitive rather than total-mass inequality and search badly unbalanced alpha,beta.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/arbitrary_delay_lemma.md: exponentially large combined mass coexists with a persistent mod-5 no-adjacency obstruction

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A compatible tower of bounded-height residue representatives converges to an integer interval certificate.
mechanisms.kill_test: Audit compactness: kill if boundedness depends on q or loses distinct-use supports.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/residue_core_bridge.md: compatible residues without disjoint support and uniform quotient height do not compactify to an interval

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Disjoint residue representatives with quotient-height spread H and a disjoint q-multiple quotient interval of length at least H produce an explicit consecutive integer interval.
mechanisms.kill_test: Reconstruct every integer in the claimed interval with disjoint supports and exact endpoints.
